title: Fungi
notes: Fungi have both useful and harmful effects in our daily life.
Medicinal value: Different types of fungi are used in the production of numbers of drugs.
Penicillin, claviformin and other antibiotic are extracted from Penicillium species.
Vitamin B-complex, vitamin A and vitamin B-12 are obtained from Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Eremothemium ashbyii respectively.
Different types of steroids are also synthesized from fungi.
Food value: Fungi are used as food by humans from a long time ago.
The fruiting bodies of mushroom are used as food due to their high protein content and have good amount of vitamins, minerals and very less amount of fat.

Industrial value: Fungi are used in the production of different types of commercially important products such as alcoholic products (using yeast like, Saccharomyces, Rhizopus, Penicillium etc), bakery products (using yeast), Cheese (using Penicillium species), enzymes (like, amylase, cellulose, invertase etc.
